xna-type.name: AvatarDescription
xna-type.summary: Provides access to the methods and properties of the description data for an avatar.
xna-type.remarks: The AvatarDescription object contains an internal data buffer used by the avatar renderer when loading and animating a gamer's avatar. There are also methods for getting the height and gender of the avatar. AvatarDescription also provides a number of methods that you can use to create a new random AvatarDescription object or to retrieve one from an existing avatar description buffer.

constructor.summary: Creates a new instance of AvatarDescription using an existing data buffer.

parameters.parameter: Existing buffer used to store the information of the newly-created avatar. Use the buffer specified by the Description property of a valid AvatarDescription object. Common scenarios include the recreation of random avatars that were created earlier or when avatar decription data is sent over a network to all signed-in gamers. Once that data is received, local avatar descriptions and renderers are created for each remote gamer avatar. Results are undefined if buffers from other sources are used.

property.name: BodyType
property.summary: Gets the body type of the avatar based on the description data.

property.name: Description
property.summary: Internal description buffer of the avatar, stored as a byte buffer.

property.name: Height
property.summary: Height of the avatar, from the feet to the top of the head.

property.name: IsValid
property.summary: Determines whether the internal data buffer is valid.
property.remarks: This property is provided only as a quick verification method for developers that receive an AvatarDescription object from the XNA framework. For example, a value of false could indicate that the user does not have an avatar.

method.name: BeginGetFromGamer
method.summary: Begins the process of getting a AvatarDescription object for a specified gamertag.

overload.summary: Begins the process of getting a AvatarDescription object for a specified gamertag.

parameters.parameter: Gamer to request the AvatarDescription for.
The method to be called once the asynchronous operation has finished.

overload.returns: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the method. Call EndGetFromGamer to access these results.

method.name: CreateRandom
method.summary: Creates an avatar of random gender, features, and clothing.

overload.summary: Creates an avatar of random gender, features, and clothing.
Creates an avatar of the specified body type with random features and clothing.

parameters.parameter: Body type of the randomly-created avatar.

overload.remarks: It is possible that a newly-created random AvatarDescription object could be an invalid avatar description buffer. For instance, the related AvatarDescription object was created by a call to CreateRandom , from within a Windows application.

method.name: EndGetFromGamer
method.summary: Ends the process of getting an AvatarDescription object for a specified gamertag.

overload.summary: Ends the process of getting an AvatarDescription object for a specified gamertag.

parameters.parameter: An IAsyncResult used to track the progress of the operation.

overload.returns: The AvatarDescription object for the specified gamertag.

event.name: Changed
event.summary: Occurs when a gamer's avatar changes.
